results.title: Faith in AI can narrow the futures individuals consider
results.snippet: Artificial intelligence (AI) predictions are increasingly used to inform human decisions. Here, using a behavioral implementation of the classic Newcomb's paradox in 1,305 participants, we show that AI predictions can also shape the reasoning people use to make a decision. In this paradigm, perceived predictive authority can alter how people reason about their future actions, leading them to forgo a guaranteed reward. Over 40% of participants treated AI as such a predictive authority about their own behavior, significantly increasing the odds of forgoing the guaranteed reward by a factor of 3…

results.title: The Specification Trap: Why Static Value Alignment Alone Is Insufficient for Robust Alignment
results.snippet: Static content-based AI value alignment is insufficient for robust alignment under capability scaling, distributional shift, and increasing autonomy. This holds for any approach that treats alignment as optimizing toward a fixed formal value-object, whether reward function, utility function, constitutional principles, or learned preference representation. Three philosophical results create compounding difficulties: Hume's is-ought gap (behavioral data underdetermines normative content), Berlin's value pluralism (human values resist consistent formalization), and the extended frame problem (an…

results.title: Aligning Language Models with Indigenous Community Cosmovision through Constitutional AI
results.snippet: Large language models (LLMs) are predominantly trained on corpora that reflect Western, anglophone worldviews. This asymmetry is not neutral: when a model answers questions about territory, community authority, or the relationship with nature, it does so from assumptions that may be alien to the communities using the system. This paper presents a system for aligning language models with the ethical principles of Indigenous communities in Latin America. Drawing on interviews with five Indigenous leaders and defenders, we built an operational cultural constitution grounded in an Indigenous cosm…

findings.evidence: 论文指出任何将对齐视为针对固定形式价值对象（奖励函数、效用函数、宪法原则、学习偏好表示）的优化方法，都面临休谟的是-应该鸿沟、柏林的价值多元论、扩展框架问题三重哲学困境

# 价值对齐与可扩展监督（含校准与不确定性）深度调研报告

**日期**：2026-10-31（UTC）  
**领域**：AI Alignment / Scalable Oversight / Calibration & Uncertainty  
**检索源数量**：30 条可引用证据（编号 [1]–[30]）  
**方法论**：deep-research + frontier-tracking + paper-survey + evidence-grading + frontier-watch

---

## 1. 进展与热点

### 1.1 近 1-2 年核心进展（按时间倒序）

> **增量判断**：2025-2026 年出现**从静态对齐转向动态/过程导向监督**的理论共识（Specification Trap [29]），并催生首个可扩展监督专用基准 [3] 与多元文化对齐共享任务 [8]。透明度治理指数 [16] 量化了监管视野的**增量扩大**（新增新兴独角兽评估）。
